title: Europe coverage evidence tranche 1F - Hungary, Malta, Liechtenstein, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Albania

safety.message: This pack onboards current official sources and creates pending proposals only. Independent review, fresh monitoring, and human-published verified rules remain required.

references.evidence_summary: Hungary's National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing publishes official guidance for electronically submitting residence-permit and related aliens-policing applications through Enter Hungary.

Malta's Identita agency identifies its Expatriates Unit as the administrator of legal migration and explains residence documents, employment residence permits, family reunification, and visa requirements.

Liechtenstein's National Administration identifies the Migration and Passport Office and explains residence permits for EEA, Swiss, and third-country citizens, including work and non-work residence applications.

Bosnia and Herzegovina's Service for Foreigners' Affairs official portal provides verified information on foreigner entry, stay, residence registration, temporary and permanent residence, forms, fees, and governing law.

Albania's Ministry of Interior publishes the official English text of Law No. 79/2021 On Aliens, covering entry, stay, employment, residence permits, responsible authorities, and foreigner rights and obligations.

batch.name: v10.22.24 Europe evidence tranche 1F - HU, MT, LI, BA, AL
batch.notes: Official-source evidence for Hungary (HU), Malta (MT), Liechtenstein (LI), Bosnia and Herzegovina (BA), and Albania (AL). All five endpoints were probed on 2026-07-18 through the controlled API-container retriever, returned HTTPS 200, and scored as suitable for narrow drafting. Lithuania (LT) was excluded after the controlled probe returned HTTP 403; retrieval controls were not weakened. The tranche is limited to the described immigration, residence, permit, and foreigner-law functions and does not claim complete immigration-law coverage. Submission creates pending proposals only; independent reviewer certification remains required.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing Enter Hungary guidance
immigration_assessment.rationale: Hungary's National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing publishes official guidance for residence-permit and related aliens-policing applications through Enter Hungary. This supports a proposal that Hungary directly administers the relevant immigration and residence services through the National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing.

source_onboarding.evidence_notes: Controlled API-container probe on 2026-07-18 returned HTTPS 200 with 12,962 characters of extracted content and a quality score of 82, covering residence applications, Enter Hungary submission, employment, family, and related aliens-policing procedures. Keep the initial certification limited to the services explicitly described.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: Identita Working and Residing in Malta guidance
immigration_assessment.rationale: Malta's Identita agency states that its Expatriates Unit administers the legal migration process and processes and issues residence documents, including employment residence permits and family-reunification cases. This supports a proposal that Malta directly administers the relevant immigration services through Identita.
